No: 35+1+2 = 38 invoices with payments, 38+3 = 41? Invoices total 40: 35 correct + 3 unpaid + 1 duplicated + 2 mismatched = 41 — off by one, so let me recount: 40 invoices; 3 unpaid, 1 duplicated, 2 mismatched → 40-3-1-2 = 34 fully paid. Payment rows: 41 total − 3 ignored = 38; 34×1 + 1×2 + 2×1 = 38. ✓ Consistent.

**[assumptions]** "resend" on INV-1015 counts as a second payment (duplicated), not a correction; the unidentified PIX 1099 (1500.00) is ignored per README since no invoice is identifiable; amount comparison is exact (cents).

**[next]** Finance should collect INV-1008, INV-1030, INV-1033; recover the duplicate 1904.29 on INV-1015; and chase the shortfalls on INV-1021 (250.00) and INV-1036 (861.92). No browser tabs or apps were opened, so nothing to close.
